node.surface.note: The ONLY per-instance token field in a PageSpec: the surface a node sits on. Styling otherwise belongs to the section contracts; there is no free-form token override field. Unknown surfaces are rejected by the schema enum and by semantic_validate.py TOKEN_UNKNOWN.
